paper_metadata.title: Effect of microstructure on high-cycle fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy forging at cryogenic temperatures

evidence.quote: The effect of microstructure on the high-cycle fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy forging at cryogenic temperature was investigated using four materials with different microstructure.
(α+β) annealed material were heated for 7.2ks at 1213 K followed by water-quenching and for 10.2ks air-cooled at 978 K.

The β-annealed materials were heated for 3.6ks at 1323 K (above β-transus temperature), and then furnace-cooled (FC), air-cooled (AC) and water-quenched (WQ). Finally, FC, AC and WQ materials were followed by 7.2ks furnace-cooled at 993 K.
